title: The curve scaling limit of half-plane double dimers

abstractEnglish: We prove that the complete double-dimer loop ensemble for the Temperleyan square lattice in the upper half-plane converges to nested CLE4. The convergence holds along the full mesh limit and matches every macroscopic loop as an unparametrized curve. This resolves the half-plane Temperleyan form of the double-dimer CLE4 scaling-limit conjecture.
titleEn: The curve scaling limit of half-plane double dimers
titleZh: 半平面双二聚体的曲线标度极限

details.overview: 稿件研究上半平面Temperleyan方格上的完全双二聚体环系综，证明其收敛到嵌套CLE4。摘要表示，收敛沿完整网格极限成立，且每个宏观环作为无参数曲线匹配，从而解决了双二聚体CLE4标度极限猜想的半平面Temperleyan形式。该结果属于概率论与统计物理中的随机几何。
keyPoints: 证明半平面Temperleyan方格双二聚体环系综收敛到嵌套CLE4。
收敛沿完整网格极限，每个宏观环作为无参数曲线匹配。
